newsitem.title: UK: Microvitec gains after newspaper tip.
newsitem.headline: Microvitec gains after newspaper tip.

text.p: Shares in Microvitec jumped 4-3/4 pence to 24 as the computer company was tipped as a recovery stock for 1997 in the Sunday Telegraph, market makers said.

The newspaper said Microvitec, which saw its shares plunge this year amid two profit warnings, was operating in growth markets and could be a takeover target if management failed to demonstrate a firm grip.
Microvitec's last profit warning came on December 9 when its said that slow market acceptance of new products would result in year profits which would be significantly below market expectations.
Microvitec's shares peaked at 71-1/2 pence on June 3, just before worries over deteriorating market conditions sent them into a tailspin.
